title: Do not waste the peace forgiveness brings
summary: Forgiveness is received before peace is sustained. The blessed heart answers mercy by protecting the joy it has been given.
takeaway: Treat received forgiveness as a peace you are responsible to honor.
lifeApplication: When relief comes, do not spend it immediately on noise or old complaint. Give the first clear minutes back to Bani, gratitude, or one repaired action.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord’s forgiveness gives lasting peace and bliss before the heart knows how to manufacture either.
source.lifeApplication: After peace returns, answer it with Bani before ordinary noise takes over.

evidence.coreClaim: The Lord’s forgiveness gives lasting peace and bliss before the heart knows how to manufacture either.
evidence.turn: The shabad begins with mercy already given, so the human response is stewardship of peace.
